description: diff-scope scenarios (plan §13 Diff checks + Evasion matrix). Each scenario is applied to `base` (merged with the scenario's own `base`, if any) in a temp git repo. `scenarios` and `evasion` run committed on a feature branch and uncommitted/untracked on main; `ecosystems` (per-language catalog coverage) and `benign` (false-positive guards: ordinary changes that must stay quiet) run once each, rotating committed, uncommitted and staged-but-uncommitted. `expect` lists the severities of non-info findings per check; checks not listed must have none. `deps_expect` does the same for deps-check (offline, resolved through `registry`). {{AWS_KEY}}, {{GH}} and {{PK}} are replaced at runtime by values built from parts.
